summary: Rekor has an OOM Condition due to Unbounded gzip Decompression in Alpine APK Parsing Logic

upstream_provenance.train_cutoff_basis: The fix commit 759b98e2 landed upstream on 2026-05-21 (GitHub API committer date). The CVE record carries no publication date, so the corrective-change date is used as the training-cutoff bound.
modifications: Repackaged the upstream source tree at the vulnerable commit e4303a87 as environment/src.tgz.
Added the Harbor task environment (environment/Dockerfile, environment/scripts/, environment/config/config.toml) that builds the image and drives grading.

Authored the reproduction harness with a held-out reproducer at tests/data/poc.bin, distinct from the reference reproducer at solution/poc.bin. The control probe re-uses tests/data/poc.bin rather than a separate fixture.
Authored the grading artifacts tests/test_output.py, tests/test_weights.json and tests/rubric.json and the verifier entrypoint tests/test.sh.
Reinitialised a pristine in-image git baseline so the agent's diff contains only its own edits.
upstream_provenance.originality_claim_note: This instance is derived, not original. The defect, the base tree and the corrective change are upstream sigstore/rekor work; only the harness, corpus and grading artifacts are authored here.
